Fixed (dispatch.bash's dojo invocation now `cd`s explicitly) and verified via a new zero-cost pre-flight mechanism check (no live claude call) before this re-freeze. See jeeves tasks.jeeves event #95146 (/loopback) for full root-cause + void-decision record.
